A species of '''unidentified ray-shaped predator''' was native to [[Endor|The Forest Moon of Endor]]. One was housed by [[King/Legends|King]] [[Elbo]] in his [[Coral Castle]]. The beast was kept in an isolated pool, above which hung a large [[Wood/Legends|wooden]] crate. Intruders would sometimes be trapped in the wooden crate, and the ray monster would harass the prisoners by jumping from its pool and snapping at the crate, trying to get at those inside. When the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]], [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]], [[Latara/Legends|Latara]], and [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] were trapped in the crate, Teebo accidentally increased the size of the monster due to a misplaced potion. The much larger monster was able to get at the crate more easily, and it threatened to devour both the crate and the Ewoks. However, Elbo stopped the monster from doing so at the last minute.
